architecture_summary.application_type: Full-stack TypeScript Web Application (React 19 SPA + Node.js/Express 4 Backend + Firebase Auth & Firestore + S3-Compatible/Local Media Object Storage)
trust_boundaries: Public Internet -> Express Delivery & Abuse Guard (src/utils/serverDeliveryAndAbuseGuard.ts)
Client Browser -> Firebase Authentication & Firestore Rules (firestore.rules, src/firebase.ts)
Authenticated User / Admin -> Express API Routes (src/utils/serverAdminAndTelegramSecurity.ts)
Express Server -> External Providers (Gemini API, Telegram Bot API, OpenStreetMap Tile/Nominatim/Overpass, Open-Meteo, S3 Object Storage)
data_stores: Local/S3 Object Storage (.object-storage-bucket/index.json with 0o600 atomic writes)
Server Disk Cache (.cache-data.json and .runtime-config.json with 0o600 permissions, zero secrets, zero buyer PII)

security_domains.name: Authentication, Identity & Session Management
security_domains.notes: Firebase ID token verification enforces checkRevoked=true, project aud/iss match (gen-lang-client-0713157837), email_verified===true, canonical email normalization, single-header extraction (rejecting duplicate Authorization/X-Admin-Token headers), and constant-time secret comparison via crypto.timingSafeEqual.

security_domains.name: Authorization, Access Control & Tenant Isolation
security_domains.notes: Enforces RBAC/BOLA across all 10 Firestore collections and Express routes. Remediated SEC-FINDING-003 in firestore.rules to validate all array elements (0..N) of imageUrls, objectStorageKeys, and objectStorageObjectIds in /bargains, and SEC-FINDING-004 in serverPublisherBargains.ts to enforce doc ID validation and per-owner listing quotas.

security_domains.name: Secrets, Keys, Credentials & Environment Hygiene
security_domains.notes: SECRET_ENV_KEYS (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, ADMIN_API_SECRET, OBJECT_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY, OBJECT_STORAGE_SECRET_KEY) are never persisted to .runtime-config.json or .cache-data.json, masked in Admin UI via maskSecretValue(), and scrubbed from backups via scrubSecretsFromBackupObject().

security_domains.name: API, Transport, CORS, CSRF, Headers & Network Boundaries
security_domains.notes: Enforces CSP, HSTS in production, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY on /api/*, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, query credential rejection (CREDENTIALS_IN_QUERY_FORBIDDEN), and HTTP server timeout hardening.

security_domains.name: Database, Data Store, Query, ORM & Storage Security
security_domains.notes: No SQL/ORM is used; data store is Cloud Firestore + atomic 0o600 local JSON caches. Remediated SEC-FINDING-003 in firestore.rules so bounded list fields on /bargains validate every index 0..N.

security_domains.name: Input Validation, Parsing, Serialization & Output Encoding
security_domains.notes: Enforces prototype-pollution-safe JSON parsing, CSV formula injection escaping, Leaflet HTML attribute escaping (escapeHtmlAttr), safe JSON-LD serialization, and remediated SEC-FINDING-005 (Overpass QL regex metacharacter stripping and Iran geographic coordinate bounds in serverBoundaryProtocol.ts).

security_domains.name: Frontend, Browser, DOM, Mobile & Client-Side Security
security_domains.notes: Leaflet 1.9.4 loaded with SHA-256 Subresource Integrity (SRI) and crossorigin=anonymous in index.html; all dynamic map tooltips and divIcons escape untrusted strings via escapeHtmlAttr(); external links use buildExternalDivarUrl() and rel='noopener noreferrer'.

security_domains.name: Payment, Monetization, Credits, Billing & Financial Logic
security_domains.notes: Sponsor tariffs and expiration dates are computed exclusively server-side. Remediated SEC-FINDING-001 in verifyX402PaymentHeaders() (enforcing minimum product price, timestamp freshness window, and replay deduplication) and redacted paid dossier fields in ?simulate=1 mode.

security_domains.name: File Upload, Media Processing, Parsing & Object Storage
security_domains.notes: Enforces magic-byte signature validation, WebP re-encoding via sharp, video container safety checks, atomic 0o600 writes, and path traversal containment. Remediated SEC-FINDING-002 in serverBackupAndChunkUploadRoutes.ts by bounding concurrent chunk sessions per user (<=2) and globally (<=25), validating Base64 chunks, using canonical object keys, and stripping internal localFileName/ownerUid metadata from responses.

security_domains.name: SSRF, Outbound Requests, Webhooks & Third-Party Integrations
security_domains.notes: Outbound requests use strict timeouts, fixed upstream origins, DNS/private-IP SSRF guards (validateOutboundUrlAndResolveDns), and Telegram webhook secret + replay deduplication. Remediated SEC-FINDING-005 in serverBoundaryProtocol.ts to strip regex metacharacters from Overpass QL queries and enforce Iran coordinate bounds.

security_domains.name: Background Jobs, Queues, Workers, Crons, WebSockets & Async Flows
security_domains.notes: Single-flight market pulse deduplication (marketPulseFlights), bounded orphan audit pagination (ORPHAN_AUDIT_MAX_JOBS, ORPHAN_AUDIT_MAX_PAGES_PER_STEP), and lease/idempotency guards prevent overlapping background task storms.

security_domains.name: Rate Limiting, Quotas, Abuse Prevention & Cost Protection
security_domains.notes: Enforces IP rate buckets, exponential abuse cooldowns, and per-UID quotas. Remediated SEC-FINDING-001, SEC-FINDING-002, and SEC-FINDING-004 by rate-limiting commercial dataset routes, chunked upload init/complete routes, contact-reveal routes, and data-correction routes.

security_domains.name: Logging, Monitoring, Auditability, Error Handling & Privacy
security_domains.notes: Enforces explicit privacy consent (buyer-alert-2026-10-v1), 90-day retention metadata, zero buyer PII persistence to disk (.cache-data.json), credential redaction in logs, and hash-chained admin security audit trails.

security_domains.name: Cryptography, Randomness, Hashing, Signing & Token Security
security_domains.notes: Uses AES-256-GCM + scrypt KDF + AAD + HMAC-SHA256 for encrypted backups, CSPRNG (crypto.randomBytes / crypto.getRandomValues) for IDs, and timingSafeEqual for secret/HMAC comparisons. Remediated SEC-FINDING-001 to prevent x402 HMAC signature replay.

security_domains.name: Dependencies, Supply Chain, Build, CI/CD & Runtime Containers
security_domains.notes: CDN assets in index.html use pinned versions and SHA-256 SRI hashes; build and architecture integrity are verified via scripts/check-architecture.ts and pinned SHA-256 digests.

security_domains.name: Infrastructure, Cloud, IaC, Reverse Proxy, Edge, DNS & Deployment
security_domains.notes: Trusted proxy hops are strictly bounded (resolveTrustedProxySetting 1..5, default false); canonical redirects validate safe return paths and never trust unvalidated Host headers.

security_domains.name: AI / LLM / Agent / Prompt / Tool / RAG / MCP Security
security_domains.notes: Enforces prompt injection detection (detectPromptInjection), XML delimiter isolation (<untrusted_contract_clause>), strict responseSchema, concurrency cap (activeContractAiCalls < 3), 8s AbortSignal timeout, and read-only zero-PII allowlisted MCP tools.

security_domains.name: Search, Indexing, Scraping, Public Content, SEO & Enumeration
security_domains.notes: SSR SEO meta injection escapes HTML text/attributes and serializes JSON-LD safely; robots.txt disallows /api/; public listings never expose ownerUid or unredacted phone numbers in JSON-LD.

security_domains.name: State Machines, Concurrency, Idempotency & Business Invariants
security_domains.notes: Enforces bargain and listing lifecycle state transitions, sponsor reservation idempotency keys, file-locked journal updates, and atomic Firestore batch invariants between /bargains and /bargainOwners.

security_domains.name: Feature Flags, Remote Config, Admin Panels & Internal Tools
security_domains.notes: Client feature flags (loadValidatedFeatureFlags) are strictly UI toggles and never grant privilege; /appConfig/{configId} writes require isAdmin() in Firestore rules; high-risk admin operations support separation-of-duties (SoD) and require primary bootstrap admin.

security_domains.name: Import / Export, Archives, Reports, Templates & Document Generation
security_domains.notes: CSV exports neutralize formula injection (escapeCsvCell); archive inspection blocks Zip Slip path traversal, symlinks, and compression bombs (inspectArchiveExtractionSafety); encrypted backups verify AES-256-GCM authTag and HMAC before JSON parsing.

security_domains.name: Notifications, Email, SMS, Push, Chat & Messaging Channels
security_domains.notes: Telegram send endpoint rejects client-supplied botToken/channelId (FORBIDDEN_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS), requires admin auth, enforces 60s content hash deduplication, and sanitizes notification templates and links.

security_domains.name: Internationalization, Unicode, Encoding, Locale & Text Normalization
security_domains.notes: Normalizes Persian/Arabic digits before numeric/phone validation (normalizeDigitsToEnglish), strips zero-width/bidi control characters in search normalization, and enforces ASCII-only canonical email identities.

security_domains.name: Caching, CDN, Edge State, Browser Storage & Shared Data Leakage
security_domains.notes: Authenticated, admin, and mutation API responses enforce Cache-Control: private, no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate and Vary: Origin, Authorization, X-Admin-Token, Accept-Encoding.

security_domains.name: Account Lifecycle, Recovery, Invitations, Delegation & Offboarding
security_domains.notes: Delegated admin lookup verifies role==='admin', canonical email match, and revoked!==true && disabled!==true; account export (/api/account/export-data) and deletion (/api/account/delete) require verified user auth and explicit confirmation.

security_domains.name: Testing, Fuzzing, Regression Coverage & Security Verification
security_domains.notes: Added automated regression assertions in tests/security-remediation-421-840.test.ts covering SEC-FINDING-001 through SEC-FINDING-005 and validating .security-remediation/STATE.json and EXECUTION_PROTOCOL.md integrity.

security_domains.name: Backup, Restore, Disaster Recovery, Migration & Operational Resilience
security_domains.notes: Backup export/restore requires primary bootstrap admin (disallowStaticToken: true), AES-256-GCM + HMAC verification, key rotation support, and excludes protected collection keys (admins) during restore preflight.

findings.title: x402 Payment Proof Replay, Underpayment Acceptance, and Unredacted Dossier Simulation Bypass
findings.evidence: verifyX402PaymentHeaders() only checked Number(parsed.amountUsdMicros) <= 0 rather than comparing against the product's pricePerRequestUsdMicros, did not validate timestampIso freshness or deduplicate consumed payment proofs against replay, and GET /api/v1/commerce/neighborhood-dossier/:hoodId?simulate=1 returned full unredacted buyPerSqm and rahn80m values without rate limiting.

findings.title: Unbounded Concurrent Chunked Upload Sessions and Internal Storage Metadata Disclosure
findings.evidence: activeChunkSessions had no per-user or global session cap and upload-init/upload-complete were not in the upload rate-limit bucket, allowing authenticated callers to allocate unbounded in-memory chunk buffers; upload-complete also returned internal localFileName and ownerUid fields in the HTTP response.

findings.title: Firestore Rules List-Tail Validation Bypass on Bargain Media Arrays
findings.evidence: isValidBargainSubmission() in firestore.rules validated only index [0] of imageUrls (max 5), objectStorageKeys (max 6), and objectStorageObjectIds (max 6), leaving elements at indices 1..N unvalidated for type and string length.

findings.title: Unbounded Publisher Bargain Map Growth, Unvalidated Listing ID, and Unthrottled Contact Reveal / Data Corrections
findings.evidence: POST /api/my-bargains did not validate rawId with isValidFirestoreDocId or enforce per-owner/global listing caps on serverPublishedBargains; POST /api/bargains/:id/reveal-contact and POST /api/data-corrections lacked dedicated rate/account quota checks.

findings.title: Overpass QL Regex Metacharacter Injection and Missing Coordinate Bounds on Boundary Resolve Endpoint
findings.evidence: fetchOverpassWayPolygon() interpolated q.name into an Overpass QL regex clause (["name"~"..."]) while only stripping ["\\<>], leaving regex metacharacters unescaped; POST /api/neighborhood-boundaries/resolve did not enforce Iran geographic bounds (lat 24..41, lng 43..64).

findings.title: OSM Tile Proxy Stored XSS via image/svg+xml, Unchecked Raster Magic Bytes, and Unbounded Upstream Tile Size / Inflight Concurrency
findings.evidence: fetchTileFromMirror() only checked contentType.startsWith('image/'), accepting image/svg+xml payloads with executable scripts and caching them for 7 days without magic-byte verification, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, a maximum tile byte cap, or an inflight request concurrency limit.

findings.title: Unpersisted pending_delete Media State on Bargain Rejection, Unbounded sponsorIdempotencyMap, and Unthrottled Financial Validation
findings.evidence: POST /api/admin/bargains/approve mutated item.deletionState = 'pending_delete' in memory on objectStoreIndex when rejecting a bargain without calling persistObjectStoreIndexNow(), allowing rejected media to become accessible again after server restart; sponsorIdempotencyMap had no size cap; POST /api/bargains/validate-financials lacked IP rate limiting.

findings.title: Unthrottled /api/telegram-digest Market Pulse Trigger and Unbounded recentTelegramIdempotency Map
findings.evidence: GET /api/telegram-digest invoked getOrUpdateMarketPulse() without IP rate limiting, and recentTelegramIdempotency stored message hashes without a capacity cap.

findings.title: Runtime Env Config Privilege Boundary, Static Token Mutation & Storage Endpoint SSRF
findings.evidence: updateRuntimeEnvConfig() accepted arbitrary strings for FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, ADMIN_EMAIL, OBJECT_STORAGE_ENDPOINT, and OBJECT_STORAGE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL without validating HTTPS/non-private hostnames or locking FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, and POST /api/admin/env-config did not set disallowStaticToken: true.

findings.title: Unvalidated Gemini Grounding URI Scheme and Unbounded Disk Cache Macro Rate Hydration
findings.evidence: performGeminiDeepMarketSearch() pushed grounding chunk.web.uri directly into sources without enforcing https:// scheme, and loadDiskPersistedCache() spread parsed.liveMacroRates without numeric clamping.

findings.title: Unthrottled Air Quality Endpoint Invoking Market Pulse Engine
findings.evidence: GET /api/air-quality invoked getOrUpdateMarketPulse(city, false) without per-IP rate limiting.

findings.title: BREACH Compression Side-Channel on Authenticated Responses & Missing Private Cache Prefixes
findings.evidence: compressPayloadIfAccepted() applied Brotli/Gzip compression even when hasAuthenticationHeaders(req) or /api/admin/ was true, and resolveApiCacheControlHeader() omitted /api/my- and /api/publisher/ prefixes.

findings.title: Unbounded Coordinate-Keyed Weather Cache Map
findings.evidence: weatherCache keyed by lat.toFixed(2),lng.toFixed(2) across the Iran bounding box had no maximum entry cap or expired-entry eviction.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on Metadata Routes and Unbounded compareParam Pattern
findings.evidence: injectDynamicSeoMeta() split compareParam on '-' without validating /^\d{1,4}-\d{1,4}$/, and /manifest.json, /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt, and /api/openapi.json did not set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

findings.title: Unbounded Sharp Image Processing Wait Queue and Unvalidated Env Public Base URL
findings.evidence: sharpWaitQueue had no maximum depth limit under concurrent upload spikes, and resolveObjectStorageRuntimeConfig() did not validate OBJECT_STORAGE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL via validateObjectStorageEndpoint().

findings.title: Unrestricted HTTP or Cloud Metadata Host in getValidatedServerConfig().appUrl
findings.evidence: getValidatedServerConfig() accepted http:// URLs in production and link-local metadata hosts (169.254.169.254, metadata.google.internal) for APP_URL when called outside startup validation.

findings.title: Unbounded In-Memory Deletion Journal Fallback Store
findings.evidence: InMemoryJournalStore.entries Map had no maximum size cap and never evicted completed terminal entries during reconciliation fallback.

findings.title: Video Container Polyglot and External dref Inspection Limited to First 4096 Bytes
findings.evidence: validateVideoContainerSafety() and verifyMediaMagicBytes() only inspected the first 4096 bytes of video/media buffers, missing trailing polyglot <script> payloads or end-of-file moov/dref external URL atoms.

findings.title: Chunked Upload Routes Missing Per-IP Upload Rate Limiting & TTL Pruning on Chunk/Complete
findings.evidence: registerBackupAndChunkUploadRoutes() was invoked without rate-limit dependencies and only ran cleanupExpiredChunkSessions() during upload-init, leaving upload-chunk and upload-complete without upload-bucket IP rate limiting or active session TTL pruning.

findings.title: Unbounded Recursion Depth and Incomplete Credential Key Stripping in serializeFirestoreAndDomainPayloadSafely
findings.evidence: serializeFirestoreAndDomainPayloadSafely() tracked circular references via WeakSet but had no recursion depth cap, array length cap, or stripping of __proto__/constructor/prototype and apiKey/botToken/accessToken/refreshToken keys.

findings.title: Object Storage Index Loader & Temp File Cleaner Missing lstat Symlink and Size Guards
findings.evidence: ensureBucketLoaded() called readFile(INDEX_FILE) without verifying via lstat that INDEX_FILE is a non-symlink regular file <=10MB, and cleanupStaleTemporaryFiles() used stat() instead of lstat().

findings.title: Unbounded Backup Ciphertext Length, Prototype Keys in Backup Restore JSON, and Unbounded One-Time Token Store
findings.evidence: decryptAndVerifyEncryptedBackup() did not bound ciphertextBase64 length before scryptSync or strip __proto__/constructor/prototype in JSON.parse, and AccountSessionAndRecoveryGuard.tokensByHash had no capacity cap.

findings.title: Unbounded IdempotencyLedger Store, Circular Reference Crash in canonicalizeJsonValue, and Prototype Keys in OptimisticConcurrencyStore
findings.evidence: canonicalizeJsonValue() lacked circular reference and depth bounds, IdempotencyLedger.store had no TTL pruning or size ceiling, and OptimisticConcurrencyStore.applyPartialUpdate() did not filter __proto__/constructor/prototype keys.

findings.title: Unbounded App Check Replay Sets, Unbounded Failure Reason Keys, and Array/CRLF Header Handling
findings.evidence: consumedMiddlewareTokenHashes and consumedLimitedUseTokenDigests grew without bound, observabilityStats.byFailureReason had no distinct key cap, and verifyAndEnforceAppCheckAndAuthSeparation() did not reject multi-element array or CRLF/whitespace tokens.

findings.title: Journal Lock and Record Readers Missing lstat Symlink and Size Guards
findings.evidence: tryReclaimStaleLockFile() used stat() instead of lstat() without a lock file size limit, and FileJournalStore.readUnlocked() read journal JSON files without checking lstat() for symlinks or oversized files.

findings.title: Unbounded DistributedTraceCollector Spans, W3C All-Zero ParentSpanId Acceptance, and Unsanitized PortableMemoryStorageAdapter Metadata
findings.evidence: DistributedTraceCollector.spans grew without bound on every traced span and parseTraceparent() accepted all-zero parentSpanId (0000000000000000); PortableMemoryStorageAdapter.putObject() lacked backslash/control-char key validation, capacity bounds, and __proto__/constructor/prototype metadata filtering.

findings.title: Symlink Following via stat() in Orphan Audit Job Reader/Cleaner and Media File Serving Route
findings.evidence: loadOrphanAuditJob(), cleanupExpiredOrphanAuditJobs(), and GET /api/object-storage/file/:objectId used fs.promises.stat() instead of lstat() with symlink rejection, and loadOrphanAuditJob() did not strip prototype-pollution keys in JSON.parse.

findings.title: Unbounded Clause Length and Unsanitized contractType Reflection in Local Legal Rule Engines
findings.evidence: runLocalLegalRuleEngine() executed regexes and echoed clauseText/contractType without clamping input length (<=8000 chars) or stripping control characters and HTML angle brackets.

findings.title: Non-Constant-Time HMAC Comparison on Pagination Cursors & Audit Checkpoints, and Unbounded Rate-Limit Counter Map
findings.evidence: decodeAndVerifyPaginationCursor() and verifyAuditChainAgainstCheckpoint() used !== instead of crypto.timingSafeEqual for HMAC verification, decodeAndVerifyPaginationCursor() lacked cursor length and prototype-key guards, and PersistentRateLimitCoordinator.sharedCounters grew without bound.

findings.title: Unbounded Incident/Webhook/Preflight/Tombstone/Challenge Stores and Prototype/ID Mutation in applyVersionedDocumentMutation
findings.entrypoint: createSecurityIncidentTicket(), DurableWebhookEventIdempotencyStore, runBackupRestorePreflight(), markRecordTombstoned(), applyVersionedDocumentMutation(), issueDestructiveActionChallenge()
findings.evidence: In-memory Maps for incidentTickets, webhook idempotency, restorePreflightStore, tombstonedDocumentIds, and destructiveChallenges had no capacity bounds, and applyVersionedDocumentMutation() spread proposedPatch without stripping __proto__/constructor/prototype or locking storedRecord.id.

findings.title: Unbounded TelegramCallbackTokenRegistry, Unbounded CSV Row Serialization, and /\ Open-Redirect Path in Notification Links
findings.evidence: TelegramCallbackTokenRegistry.tokens grew without pruning expired/consumed tokens, serializeSafeCsvDocument() had no maximum row limit, and sanitizeNotificationTemplateAndLink() did not reject /\ or control characters in targetPath.

findings.title: Case-Sensitive HTTP Method-Override Header Check, Unhandled Circular Reference in validateFirestoreDocumentComplexity, and Prefix-Collision Origin Bypass in validateSafeClipboardWriteRequest
findings.evidence: detectForbiddenMethodOverride() only checked lowercase header keys on raw header maps, validateFirestoreDocumentComplexity() called JSON.stringify(doc) before checking for circular references via WeakSet, and validateSafeClipboardWriteRequest() used raw.startsWith(canonicalOrigin) instead of strict URL origin comparison.

findings.title: Unbounded Chunk Assembly & Non-Constant-Time Checksum Comparison in verifyUploadedChunksIntegrity, and Encoded Traversal / Root Config Exposure in validateSafeStaticFileTarget
findings.evidence: verifyUploadedChunksIntegrity() did not bound chunk count or expectedTotalBytes before Buffer.concat or use crypto.timingSafeEqual on SHA-256 hex digests, and validateSafeStaticFileTarget() did not block URL-encoded traversal (%2e/%2f/%5c/%00) or root config files (package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts, firebase-blueprint.json, architecture-baseline.json).

findings.title: Unbounded Buffer-to-String Conversion in detectPolyglotOrTrailingPayloadInMedia, Unvalidated Hex Digest in evaluateMediaQuarantineStateTransition, and Unbounded Sponsor/Lease Maps
findings.evidence: detectPolyglotOrTrailingPayloadInMedia() converted full media buffers to strings instead of bounded head/tail windows, evaluateMediaQuarantineStateTransition() did not verify hex SHA-256 format, and activeSponsorSlotByHood / committedGenByCity / DistributedJobLeaseCoordinator.leases lacked TTL pruning and capacity bounds.

findings.title: Unbounded InboundWebhookAuthenticator Replay Set and Head-Only Polyglot Scan in inspectAndSanitizeImageUploadBuffer
findings.evidence: InboundWebhookAuthenticator.processedEvents grew without bound on every verified webhook event, and inspectAndSanitizeImageUploadBuffer() only inspected the first 128 bytes for active markup, missing trailing PHP/script/SVG polyglot payloads.

findings.title: Non-Constant-Time CSRF Token Comparison, Unhandled Circular Reference & Prototype Keys in validateBoundedRequestPayload, and Prototype-Backed Patch in filterAllowedMutationFields
findings.evidence: evaluateCsrfProtection() used !== instead of crypto.timingSafeEqual, validateBoundedRequestPayload() called JSON.stringify before checking circular references or __proto__/constructor/prototype keys, and filterAllowedMutationFields() used a standard prototype object for sanitizedPatch.

findings.title: Unbounded Sponsor/Consent Event Stores, Unbounded Listing Price History Revisions, and Head-Only PDF Script Scan in validateContractDocumentBuffer
findings.evidence: sponsorFinancialEvents, immutableConsentTrail, currentConsentStateByUidAndPurpose, and appendListingPriceHistory() had no upper capacity bounds, and validateContractDocumentBuffer() only scanned the first 256KB of PDFs up to 5MB for /JavaScript, missing trailer-positioned scripts.

findings.title: Unbounded OIDC State Map, Unbounded Notification Suppression/Idempotency Stores, and Prototype Keys in Telemetry & Notification Template Maps
findings.evidence: OidcAndOAuthFlowSecurityGuard.activeStates and NotificationDeliverabilityPipeline suppressionSet/sentIdempotencyKeys grew without bound, and sanitizeTelemetryEventAndUrl() / submitNotification() copied untrusted keys into standard objects without filtering __proto__/constructor/prototype.

findings.title: Protocol-Relative (//) and Traversal (..) Bypass in Printable Report SSRF Check & Push Click URL, and Symlink Following in Build Artifact Auditor
findings.evidence: isSsrfOrLocalResourceUrl() and buildSafePushNotificationPayload() accepted protocol-relative URLs (//evil.example) and .. segments via permissive /^\/[A-Za-z0-9_\-/?.]+$/ regexes, subscriptionsByEndpoint had no size cap, and auditProductionBuildArtifacts() did not skip symbolic links before readFileSync().

findings.title: Unbounded In-Memory Maps Across Inquiry Lead Guard, Media Provenance Registry, Conversion Funnel, Contact Reveal Guard, and Multi-Tab / Bulk Coordinators
findings.entrypoint: RealEstateInquiryAndLeadGuard, MediaProvenanceAndReuseRegistry, AuthoritativeConversionFunnelTracker, ContactAndLocationPrivacyDisclosureGuard, CrossTabSessionAndDraftCoordinator, SafeBulkOperationCoordinator
findings.evidence: In-memory Maps/Sets for inquiries, media provenance, funnel events, contact reveal counters, multi-tab sessions/revisions, listing transition history, and bulk idempotency keys lacked capacity bounds.

findings.title: Protocol-Relative URL Bypass in Client HREF_OR_SRC_URL Sanitizer and Unbounded Recursion in inspectNestedPrivilegeEscalation
findings.evidence: auditAndSanitizeClientRenderingPayload matched HREF_OR_SRC_URL against /^\/[A-Za-z0-9_\-/?.=&%]*$/ which permitted protocol-relative //evil.example URLs and .. traversal; inspectNestedPrivilegeEscalation recursively traversed nested objects without depth or WeakSet circular-reference guards; projectPublicListingResponse used {} instead of Object.create(null).

findings.title: Unbounded In-Memory Caches and Sets in Offline Mutation Queue, Viewing Slot Guard, Saved Search Manager, Cache Coherence Manager, and Leased Job Coordinator
findings.entrypoint: OfflineMutationQueueAndConflictResolver, ViewingSlotConcurrencyGuard, FavoritesAndSavedSearchAlertManager, MarketTimeSeriesRevisionGovernor, ScopedCacheCoherenceManager, LeasedBackgroundJobCoordinator
findings.evidence: processedIdempotencyKeys, reservedSlots, userFavorites, savedSearches, dispatchedAlertKeys, HistoricalPricePointRecord maps/revisions, ScopedCacheCoherenceManager store/tombstones, and LeasedBackgroundJobCoordinator activeLeases/completedKeys/deadLetterQueue lacked capacity bounds.

findings.title: Non-Constant-Time HMAC Comparison in Confidential Document Vault, Unvalidated Counter-Offer Price, Shallow Audit Redaction, and Unbounded State Maps
findings.evidence: verifyShortLivedSignedToken compared HMAC signatures using !== instead of crypto.timingSafeEqual; counterOffer did not validate positive finite newProposedPriceMillionToman or cap revisions; redactAuditSnapshot only redacted top-level keys; in-memory Maps/arrays lacked capacity bounds.

findings.title: Encoded Slash/Traversal Bypass in validateExternalBrowserNavigationSafety, Unbounded Recursion in redactSensitiveLogPayload, and Unbounded SafeBrowserStorageAdapter
findings.evidence: validateExternalBrowserNavigationSafety allowed /%2f, /%5c, .., and control characters when isInternalRedirectParam=true; redactSensitiveLogPayload recursively traversed nested objects without depth or WeakSet circular-reference guards; SafeBrowserStorageAdapter lacked prototype-key blocking and capacity bounds.

findings.title: Non-Advancing Migration Loop DoS, Prototype Keys in AI JSON Parser, Symlink/Traversal in Build HTML Asset Verifier, and Unbounded Blob/Moderation Maps
findings.evidence: runVersionedLocalDataMigrations lacked a step-progression and iteration guard; parseAndValidateStructuredAiJson parsed raw LLM JSON without stripping __proto__/constructor/prototype or bounding length; verifyProductionBuildIntegrityAndHtmlAssets did not verify distDir path containment or skip symlinks; BlobUrlLifecycleRegistry and ModerationTaskClaimCoordinator Maps lacked capacity bounds.

findings.title: Non-Constant-Time Media Signature Verification in MediaDeliveryAndSignedUrlGuard, Shallow Forensic Metadata Redaction, and Unbounded Forensic/Session Maps
findings.evidence: verifySignedMediaAccess compared HMAC signatures using !== instead of crypto.timingSafeEqual; redactMetadataObject only redacted top-level keys and left nested sensitive keys unredacted; TamperResistantForensicLedger.events, AccountSessionAndRecoveryGuard Maps, and MediaDeliveryAndSignedUrlGuard Sets lacked capacity bounds.

findings.title: Overly Broad .run.app Suffix Match in evaluateCorsOriginPolicy, Unbounded Recursion in computeCanonicalPayloadFingerprint, and Unbounded Cursor Length in decodeAndValidatePaginationCursor
findings.evidence: evaluateCorsOriginPolicy allowed any origin ending in .run.app with credentials instead of restricting to HTTPS ais-(dev|pre) Cloud Run origins; computeCanonicalPayloadFingerprint lacked WeakSet circular-reference and depth<=12 bounds; decodeAndValidatePaginationCursor lacked cursor length bounds and prototype-key filtering.

findings.title: Unfiltered Prototype Keys in sanitizeUserEditableProfilePayload, Unsanitized hoodName/id in migrateLegacyPriceThresholdSubscription, and Unsanitized AI Fields in validateContractAnalysisResult
findings.evidence: SERVER_MANAGED_PROFILE_FIELDS did not include __proto__/constructor/prototype or inspect own property names; migrateLegacyPriceThresholdSubscription passed raw r.hoodName and unbounded r.id without sanitizeInput; validateContractAnalysisResult returned raw AI strings without stripping HTML/control characters or bounding array/field lengths.

findings.title: Unescaped </AUTHORITATIVE_FACTS> Tag Breakout in buildSandboxedAiPromptEnvelope, Unvalidated modelId Path in buildCloudflareAiGatewayEndpoint, and Unbounded AI Governance Stores
findings.entrypoint: buildSandboxedAiPromptEnvelope, AiContentPublicationLifecycleGate, AiTokenUsageAndCostLedger, ReproducibleBugReportCollector, AiModelRoutingManager, buildCloudflareAiGatewayEndpoint
findings.evidence: buildSandboxedAiPromptEnvelope serialized authoritativeFacts without stripping closing </AUTHORITATIVE_FACTS> tags; buildCloudflareAiGatewayEndpoint interpolated modelId without validating against .. traversal or invalid characters; in-memory AI governance Maps/arrays lacked upper capacity bounds.

findings.title: Unbounded In-Memory Event Deduplication Set, Pending Batch, Committed Events, and Feedback Rate-Limit Maps in productAnalyticsEngine.ts
findings.evidence: seenEventIds, pendingBatch, committedEvents, items, and hourlySubmissionsByActor grew without upper capacity limits or FIFO eviction.

findings.title: CSV Header Formula Injection & Embedded Newlines in buildReproducibleCrmReport, Unredacted Phone/Email PII in createSanitizedAgencyAuditEvent, and Prototype Keys in CRM Deduplication Maps
findings.evidence: buildReproducibleCrmReport joined raw header keys without quoting/formula escaping and left CR/LF newlines inside CSV cells; createSanitizedAgencyAuditEvent did not redact Iranian mobile numbers or email addresses; CRM duplicate/ownership maps used plain {} instead of Object.create(null).

findings.title: Unbounded 15-Minute Step Loop CPU DoS in computeBusinessHoursElapsed, Unbounded Outbox Processed IDs, and Unchecked NaN/Infinity Inputs in simulateMortgageEarlyRepaymentAndSellerProceeds
findings.evidence: computeBusinessHoursElapsed iterated in 15-minute increments from startMs to endMs without clamping the time span or checking Number.isFinite, allowing multi-year or MAX_SAFE_INTEGER timestamps to lock the Node.js event loop; simulateMortgageEarlyRepaymentAndSellerProceeds did not guard against NaN/Infinity inputs.

remediations.summary: Enforced minimum product price (pricePerRequestUsdMicros), timestamp freshness window (10m TTL), and SHA-256 proof digest replay protection in verifyX402PaymentHeaders(); added rate limiting and redacted paid dossier pricing fields in ?simulate=1 mode on commercial routes.

Enforced MAX_ACTIVE_CHUNK_SESSIONS_PER_USER (2) and MAX_ACTIVE_CHUNK_SESSIONS_TOTAL (25), strict Base64 chunk validation, canonical buildListingObjectKey generation, and stripping of internal localFileName/ownerUid metadata in upload-complete, plus upload rate-bucket enforcement in serverDeliveryAndAbuseGuard.ts.
Hardened isValidBargainSubmission() in firestore.rules to validate type and maximum length across all indices 0..4 of imageUrls and 0..5 of objectStorageKeys and objectStorageObjectIds.

Enforced isValidFirestoreDocId(rawId), valid Iranian mobile check on contactPhone, per-owner active listing quota (<=25), and global listing cap (<=500) in POST /api/my-bargains, plus IP rate limiting and per-account quotas on POST /api/bargains/:id/reveal-contact and POST /api/data-corrections.

Added sanitizeOverpassNeighborhoodName() stripping all regex/Overpass metacharacters before Overpass QL interpolation, and enforced Iran geographic bounding box (lat 24..41, lng 43..64) in computeApproxHexRing() and POST /api/neighborhood-boundaries/resolve.

Restricted fetchTileFromMirror() to explicit raster MIME types (image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp), added PNG/JPEG/WebP magic-byte verification, enforced MAX_TILE_BYTES (512 KB) and MAX_INFLIGHT_TILE_REQUESTS (64), and set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on /api/osm-tile/:z/:x/:y.

Persisted objectStoreIndex via persistObjectStoreIndexNow() when marking rejected bargain media as pending_delete, bounded sponsorIdempotencyMap to <=250 entries, and rate-limited POST /api/bargains/validate-financials.
Added IP rate limiting to GET /api/telegram-digest and bounded recentTelegramIdempotency to <=200 entries in POST /api/send-telegram.

Locked FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID against runtime hijacking, enforced HTTPS + non-private hostname validation (isSafeHttpsStorageUrl) on OBJECT_STORAGE_ENDPOINT and OBJECT_STORAGE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL, validated ADMIN_EMAIL format in updateRuntimeEnvConfig(), and enforced disallowStaticToken: true on POST /api/admin/env-config.
Restricted grounding chunk URIs in performGeminiDeepMarketSearch() to strict https:// URLs and clamped gold18kToman/usdToman bounds during loadDiskPersistedCache() hydration.
Added per-IP rate limiting (60 req/min) to GET /api/air-quality in server.ts.

Bypassed HTTP compression in compressPayloadIfAccepted() when hasAuthenticationHeaders(req) or /api/admin/ is present (BREACH defense), and added /api/my- and /api/publisher/ to private no-store paths in resolveApiCacheControlHeader().
Bounded weatherCache in fetchFreeCityWeather() to MAX_WEATHER_CACHE_ENTRIES (128) with TTL pruning and oldest-entry eviction.
Enforced strict /^\d{1,4}-\d{1,4}$/ validation on compareParam in injectDynamicSeoMeta() and set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on /manifest.json, /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt, and /api/openapi.json.
Validated OBJECT_STORAGE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL via validateObjectStorageEndpoint() in resolveObjectStorageRuntimeConfig() and bounded sharpWaitQueue to MAX_SHARP_WAIT_QUEUE (16) in acquireSharpSlot().
Enforced HTTPS-only APP_URL in production and rejected cloud metadata/private hosts (169.254.169.254, metadata.google.internal) in getValidatedServerConfig().
Bounded InMemoryJournalStore.entries to <=1000 records with completed-entry pruning and oldest-entry eviction in deletionJournal.ts.
Extended validateVideoContainerSafety() and verifyMediaMagicBytes() in fileSignature.ts to inspect both the first 4096 bytes and the trailing 4096 bytes for polyglot scripts and external dref URLs.

Passed rate-limit dependencies from registerSponsorAndBargainRoutes into registerBackupAndChunkUploadRoutes and enforced upload-bucket IP rate limiting and cleanupExpiredChunkSessions() across upload-init, upload-chunk, and upload-complete.

Enforced maximum recursion depth (<=12), array length cap (<=500), prototype-key stripping (__proto__, constructor, prototype), and extended credential key scrubbing (apiKey, botToken, accessToken, refreshToken) in serializeFirestoreAndDomainPayloadSafely().
Added lstat symlink and <=10MB file size validation before reading INDEX_FILE in ensureBucketLoaded() and switched cleanupStaleTemporaryFiles() to lstat() with symlink rejection.

Bounded ciphertextBase64 length (<=20MB) and stripped __proto__/constructor/prototype in JSON.parse reviver inside decryptAndVerifyEncryptedBackup(), and bounded AccountSessionAndRecoveryGuard.tokensByHash to <=1000 entries.

Added circular-reference WeakSet and depth<=12 bounds to canonicalizeJsonValue(), bounded IdempotencyLedger.store to <=2000 entries with TTL pruning, and stripped __proto__/constructor/prototype in OptimisticConcurrencyStore.applyPartialUpdate().

Bounded consumedMiddlewareTokenHashes and consumedLimitedUseTokenDigests to <=5000 entries, capped observabilityStats.byFailureReason to <=64 distinct keys, and rejected multi-value array or CRLF/whitespace App Check headers.

Switched tryReclaimStaleLockFile() and FileJournalStore.readUnlocked() in serverJournalAdapters.ts to lstat() with symlink rejection and strict file size bounds (<=16KB for locks, <=256KB for journal entries).

Capped DistributedTraceCollector.spans to <=2000 entries, rejected all-zero W3C parentSpanId in parseTraceparent(), and hardened PortableMemoryStorageAdapter.putObject() against backslash/control-char keys, oversized objects, unbounded store growth (<=1000), and prototype-pollution metadata keys.

Enforced crypto.timingSafeEqual HMAC verification in decodeAndVerifyPaginationCursor() and verifyAuditChainAgainstCheckpoint(), bounded cursor length (<=4096) with prototype-key stripping, and capped PersistentRateLimitCoordinator.sharedCounters at <=5000 entries.

Bounded incidentTickets (<=500), DurableWebhookEventIdempotencyStore (<=2000), restorePreflightStore (<=100), tombstonedDocumentIds (<=5000), and destructiveChallenges (<=250), and stripped __proto__/constructor/prototype while preserving immutable id in applyVersionedDocumentMutation().

Normalized header keys to lowercase in detectForbiddenMethodOverride(), added WeakSet circular-reference detection and try/catch around JSON.stringify in validateFirestoreDocumentComplexity(), and enforced parsed URL origin equality in validateSafeClipboardWriteRequest().

Enforced <=500 chunks, <=64MB expectedTotalBytes, pre-concat byte accounting, and crypto.timingSafeEqual SHA-256 verification in verifyUploadedChunksIntegrity(), and blocked URL-encoded traversal (%2e/%2f/%5c/%00) and root config files in validateSafeStaticFileTarget().

Bounded detectPolyglotOrTrailingPayloadInMedia() to 8KB head+tail windows with onload=/onerror= detection, enforced hex SHA-256 validation in evaluateMediaQuarantineStateTransition(), and added TTL pruning, lease TTL validation, and Map capacity bounds in securityGovernanceLifecycleAndListings.ts.

Bounded InboundWebhookAuthenticator.processedEvents to <=5000 entries with FIFO eviction and expanded inspectAndSanitizeImageUploadBuffer() to scan both 2KB head and 2KB tail windows for <svg, <html, <script, <?php, and javascript:.

Enforced crypto.timingSafeEqual in evaluateCsrfProtection(), added WeakSet circular-reference and __proto__/constructor/prototype rejection before JSON.stringify in validateBoundedRequestPayload(), and switched filterAllowedMutationFields() to Object.create(null).

Capped sponsorFinancialEvents (<=2000), immutableConsentTrail (<=5000), currentConsentStateByUidAndPurpose (<=5000), and appendListingPriceHistory() (<=200 revisions), and extended validateContractDocumentBuffer() to inspect both the first 256KB and trailing 256KB of PDF files for /JavaScript, /JS, /Launch, /EmbeddedFiles, and /RichMedia.

Pruned expired/consumed OIDC states and capped activeStates (<=2000), capped NotificationDeliverabilityPipeline suppressionSet (<=5000) and sentIdempotencyKeys (<=2000), and switched sanitizeTelemetryEventAndUrl() and submitNotification() to Object.create(null) with __proto__/constructor/prototype filtering.

Blocked protocol-relative (//, /\) and .. traversal URLs in isSsrfOrLocalResourceUrl() and buildSafePushNotificationPayload(), capped subscriptionsByEndpoint (<=5000), and skipped symbolic links in auditProductionBuildArtifacts().

Enforced capacity bounds across RealEstateInquiryAndLeadGuard, MediaProvenanceAndReuseRegistry, AuthoritativeConversionFunnelTracker, ContactAndLocationPrivacyDisclosureGuard, CrossTabSessionAndDraftCoordinator, executeListingStateTransition history, and SafeBulkOperationCoordinator.

Blocked protocol-relative (//, /\) and .. URLs in auditAndSanitizeClientRenderingPayload(), added WeakSet circular-reference and depth<=12 protection in inspectNestedPrivilegeEscalation(), and switched projectPublicListingResponse() to Object.create(null).

Enforced FIFO capacity bounds and TTL clamping across OfflineMutationQueueAndConflictResolver, ViewingSlotConcurrencyGuard, FavoritesAndSavedSearchAlertManager, MarketTimeSeriesRevisionGovernor, ScopedCacheCoherenceManager, and LeasedBackgroundJobCoordinator.

Enforced crypto.timingSafeEqual signature verification and token length bounds in ConfidentialDocumentVaultLifecycleGuard, positive finite price and revision bounds in PropertyOfferNegotiationStateMachine.counterOffer(), recursive sensitive key redaction with Object.create(null) in TamperEvidentAdministrativeAuditLedger, and FIFO capacity bounds across all Maps/logs.

Blocked prototype keys and capped memoryFallback (<=500) in SafeBrowserStorageAdapter, blocked /%2f, /%5c, .., and control characters in validateExternalBrowserNavigationSafety(), and added WeakSet circular-reference and depth<=8 protection with Object.create(null) in redactSensitiveLogPayload().

Added step progression and <=50 iteration guard in runVersionedLocalDataMigrations(), capped BlobUrlLifecycleRegistry.activeUrls (<=1000) and ModerationTaskClaimCoordinator.claims (<=2000), stripped __proto__/constructor/prototype in parseAndValidateStructuredAiJson(), and enforced distDir path containment and symlink skipping in verifyProductionBuildIntegrityAndHtmlAssets().

Enforced crypto.timingSafeEqual in MediaDeliveryAndSignedUrlGuard.verifySignedMediaAccess(), recursively redacted nested objects with Object.create(null) in redactMetadataObject(), and enforced capacity bounds across MediaDeliveryAndSignedUrlGuard, SloBurnRateAndAlertDeduplicator, TamperResistantForensicLedger, and AccountSessionAndRecoveryGuard.

Restricted .run.app CORS origins in evaluateCorsOriginPolicy() to /^https:\/\/ais-(dev|pre)-[a-z0-9-]+-\d+\.[a-z0-9-]+\.run\.app$/, added WeakSet circular-reference and depth<=12 protection in computeCanonicalPayloadFingerprint(), and added <=2048 length bound and prototype-key filtering in decodeAndValidatePaginationCursor().

Added __proto__/constructor/prototype blocking via Object.getOwnPropertyNames in sanitizeUserEditableProfilePayload(), sanitized id and hoodName in migrateLegacyPriceThresholdSubscription(), and sanitized/bounded all AI output fields in validateContractAnalysisResult().

Capped CentralizedRadarAnalyticsCollector.seenEventIds (<=5000), pendingBatch (<=1000), and committedEvents (<=5000), and capped InAppFeedbackManager.items (<=2000) and hourlySubmissionsByActor (<=2000) in productAnalyticsEngine.ts.

blockers.title: Live Production Firestore Rules Rollout & Cloud Secret Provisioning
blockers.reason: Per Section 8 of the Autonomous Security Remediation Protocol, autonomous deployment to live production (deploy_firebase) and rotation/provisioning of live external secrets (BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY, X402_SIGNING_SECRET, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, Cloudflare R2/AI Gateway credentials) require explicit operator authorization outside local code remediation.
blockers.required_operator_action: Review local diff and run deploy_firebase / provision production environment secrets when ready for live rollout.

residual_risks: In-memory rate limiting, x402 replay deduplication, and chunk upload session tracking operate per Node.js process instance; multi-instance horizontal scaling requires a shared Redis/Cloudflare Durable Object backing store.
Live production Firestore rules deployment and external secret rotation remain gated on explicit operator authorization (SEC-BLOCKER-EXT-001).
